status: statistical estimate; not an exhaustive census
target_distribution: uniform over all 256^L byte strings independently at each L

codec.note: All inputs are <=100 B, far below the 100 kB block limit.

estimator.name: deterministic-mixture multiple importance sampling with balance weights
estimator.self_normalization: the exact period-at-most-2 stratum keeps its exact mass; only the sampled complement is rescaled to the known remaining target mass
estimator.uncertainty: component-stratified Monte Carlo standard errors; normal 95% intervals are approximate and omit self-normalization covariance

coverage_limitations: Uniform sampling makes the estimator globally supported, but an unmodelled ultra-rare structural family can remain unobserved.
The proposal mixture deliberately targets short periods, small byte alphabets, and long same-byte runs; it is not proof that these exhaust every high-compression mechanism.
The 90%-of-sampled-maximum tail is relative to the observed proposal support, not a certified global optimum.
Occurrence values are weighted statistical estimates and need not be integers.
